yt_title: If you sell anything, you need proof. Here's how to get it
caption:
If you sell anything, you need proof.

A saved reel said growth needs marketing, proof and branding together. Proof is the one people skip.
1. Ask every customer for a review, with a direct link
2. Post a before and after or a result every week
3. Reply to every review

Never buy or fake reviews. Google removes fake ones.
